title: Mother Holding Toddler, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor portrait taken around the mid-1940s featuring a young mother holding her toddler. The woman has classic 1940s styled hair, wearing a patterned short-sleeve top and dark high-waisted skirt. The backdrop features corrugated metal structures, stacked wooden fruit or farm crates, a stepladder, and a white dog running in the background.
